name: Chesterfield County, VA
findings: Chesterfield County has 1,003 nonprofit organizations. 401 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 312 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Chesterfield County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Chesterfield County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 97 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 97 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few housing organizations list membership
observations.text: 3 housing organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through housing groups? Where else does that happen?
